title: Dependency edges can be added to terminal work without reopening it
description: dep add and work block route directly to runtime.addBlockingDependency, while deriveReadinessStatus preserves closed, cancelled, and verified statuses. A terminal work item can therefore acquire new open blockers while still presenting as closed or verified, hiding unresolved dependency state from closeout audits and rollups.
acceptanceCriteria: Adding or removing dependency edges on terminal work is rejected unless an explicit reopen/recompute workflow is used.
Terminal work with newly introduced blockers cannot remain closed, cancelled, or verified without an audited override.
Tests cover dep add/remove and work block against closed, cancelled, and verified work items.
